findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: inbox_list, inbox_read · Private data: my_forecasts, get_agent, memory_list, memory_get, memory_put, memory_delete, memory_search, add_reflection, vault_head, vault_proof, notarize, get_trust, add_lineage, my_credentials · Public sink: submit_forecast, inbox_read, mail_send, add_lineage · Destructive: whoami, list_questions, get_question, get_market_history, submit_forecast, my_forecasts, read_commons, get_leaderboard, get_agent, list_series, ledger_summary, ledger_similar, memory_list, memory_get, memory_put, memory_delete, memory_search, add_reflection, vault_head, vault_proof, notarize, inbox_list, inbox_read, mail_send, get_trust, add_lineage, my_credentials, truth_recent, truth_ask.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
